artworks.title: Study of Neptune and Sea Creatures (?)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a series of abstract sketches with loose, curving lines and sharp angles. The upper drawing features overlapping contours suggesting a figure amidst a cluster, resembling rocks or vines. Below, two smaller sketches depict abstract forms of kneeling figures, with one potentially gesturing towards an upright figure, conveying a scene of interaction. The figures are simplified into minimal representations of human forms.

artworks.title: Study of a Semi-Reclining Figure
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person's body, captured from the waist to their feet. The person is in a bent-over position, with a curved back and arms extended forward above their head. Their head is resting on or nestled between their arms. The facial features are not distinct, but the outline of the head is visible, suggesting short or tightly bound hair. The figure is nude with no clothing lines visible. The background is a plain, light-colored paper, emphasizing the bodily form and posture.

artworks.title: Two Airborne? Figures Reaching out to One Another
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch showing two human figures. The upper body of the first figure is visible, with the head facing slightly to the right and arms raised overhead. The second figure is positioned above the first one, extending horizontally with an arm and head visible. The facial features of both figures are minimally detailed, with no distinct hair shown. The figures lack clothing details, and the background is plain with a textured appearance from the paper's surface. No jewelry or other objects are included.

artworks.title: Two Fighting Figures
artworks.description: The sketch shows a partial view of two human figures in an expressive pose. The figure on the left has their upper body and extended arms visible, with their head tilted backward and mouth open. The second figure is behind the first, with only the back and arm visible, leaning forward slightly. Both figures are unclothed, and the background consists of light sketch lines suggesting an undefined space.

artworks.title: Two Greek Classical Figures
artworks.description: Two figures appear in a reclining position. The primary figure is partially visible, with the upper half of the body shown. They are lying down or reclining on a horizontal surface, draped in a garment that covers their torso. The figure has basic facial features and short hair, with an outstretched arm pointing upwards. The secondary figure is lightly sketched and positioned behind the first, with an arm reaching over. The background is plain, with minimal detail, and there are notations in the top left corner.

artworks.title: Two Male Nudes seen from Above
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a heavyset body, possibly including multiple figures. The drawing shows the contours and folds of the skin, focusing on midsections and limbs. There are no facial features visible, and no detailed hair representation. The figures are not wearing clothing, emphasizing the natural lines and creases of the skin. There is no jewelry or objects depicted, and the background is plain, drawing focus solely to the contoured figures.

artworks.title: Frightened Man Looking Up; Woman and Children
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch with two individuals in a reclined position. One person is depicted facing upwards with their mouth open, arms bent, and hands under their chin. The other individual is shown from the chest up, slightly turned to the side. Both figures have outlined facial features and short, textured hair. The drawing is detailed with delicate line work and presented on a simple background on paper.

artworks.title: Reclining Man; Two Women
artworks.medium: black chalk? heightened with white chalk; charcoal and graphite
artworks.description: The image contains two sketches on a piece of paper. The lower sketch features a person lying down with their back towards the viewer, propped up on their elbows. The upper sketch shows a seated figure looking downwards. Both sketches are depicted with minimal detail on a plain background.

artworks.title: Two Women's Heads
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing two figures. Both figures are depicted from the shoulders up. The figure on the left is in profile, facing left, with gently arched features, a straight nose, and slightly downturned lips, with hair suggestively styled around the ear. The figure on the right is positioned slightly behind the first, with their chin resting on their crossed arms, directing their gaze to the viewer. This figure's face is more forward-facing, with almond-shaped eyes, a slender nose, and subtle lips, and their hair is suggested to be tied or styled back. There are no distinctive details of clothing, and the background is plain, with the focus solely on the pencil sketching of the two figures.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies, including Warrior with Child [recto and verso]
artworks.medium: graphite with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with several figures. One large figure on the left holds a staff, while a smaller child-like figure holds their hand. Three smaller sketches are on the right side. Above them are indistinct markings that may suggest an abstract background. The sketch is minimalistic, with simple lines and washes against a plain background, giving it an unfinished look.

artworks.title: Woman Sketching at a Museum
artworks.description: The image shows two women in a room that appears to be an art gallery or museum. One woman is seated and focused on a notebook or sketchpad in her lap. The other woman is standing and looking at the seated woman's work. Both women are wearing elegant dresses and hats, with one woman's hair styled up and topped with feathers. There is a bust sculpture on a pedestal, a large urn, and paintings or artwork displayed in the background. A man is also visible in the distance. The room has a classical and formal ambiance with architectural elements.

artworks.title: Woman Weeping in a Sick Room
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a room. One person is lying in a bed with their head resting on a pillow, appearing to have closed eyes. They have short hair. In front of the bed, another individual is kneeling, their face turned away from the viewer, with long, dark hair tied up. The kneeling person is wearing a long-sleeved top and a long skirt. Standing to the left is a third individual with curly dark hair, wearing a long-sleeved dress. The room is decorated with framed pictures on the wall, a shelf with various small items, and a bed with a metal frame. The setting suggests a domestic interior with patterned wallpaper and wooden flooring.

artworks.title: Jean Charles Persil
artworks.artist: after Louis-Pierre Froment after Honoré Daumier
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a person's upper body. The individual is facing slightly to the side, showing a three-quarter view of the face. They have neatly styled, short hair with curls near the forehead, prominent cheekbones, a slightly pointed chin. The person is dressed formally in a high-collared, dark coat with a cravat tied around the neck. There is no visible jewelry or objects held. The background is a plain oval vignette with a textured style framing the subject. The details below the portrait include the name "Jean Charles Persil" and biographical text.

artworks.title: Landscape - Trees, Road, Huts
artworks.description: The image features a rural scene with a dirt path extending into the distance. Thatched-roof cottages line the left side of the path with a fence leading towards dense clusters of trees obscuring the horizon. Two figures walk along the path towards the vanishing point. The sky is depicted with light, textured strokes indicating cloud formations. The color scheme is sepia with dark brown tones defining trees and structures. The etching technique is visible with cross-hatching creating texture in trees and along the path. The composition evokes a quiet, pastoral atmosphere.

artworks.title: Saints Peter and Paul
artworks.description: This is a painting of an illuminated manuscript page with sheet music and an ornate initial. The page contains medieval musical notation with black notes on a five-line red stave. The text appears to be in Latin, written in a Gothic script. The left margin is adorned with a vertical line of decorative floral motifs in gold, pink, and green. In the center of the page, there is a large decorated initial which encloses a highly detailed miniature scene. This scene depicts two figures against a blue sky and landscape background, surrounded by a golden frame that integrates the initial’s swirls. The borders of the page are further decorated with elaborate and colorful vine-like patterns and small floral elements.

artworks.title: Wagoner Climbing a Hill (Roulier montant une cote)
artworks.description: The image shows a snowy landscape in a lithograph style. There is a row of buildings in the distance with a church steeple partially obscured by snow and trees. A man on horseback stands beside a cart covered with a cloth, being pulled through the snow. To the left, a group of men and horses are depicted in motion. The scene is in gray and white tones, emphasizing the winter setting and historical feel of the lithograph.

artworks.title: Landscape with Log House near a River
artworks.artist: Dutch 17th Century, formerly Jacques de Gheyn II
artworks.description: The image depicts a scenic view with a rustic path winding through a landscape. A wooden cabin is on the left, with the horizon lower in the image. A windmill is visible in the distance against rolling hills and a cloudy sky. The artwork features engravings detailing wood, foliage, and clouds, creating movement. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia and beige. Trees with bare branches flank the scene, showcasing intricate lines depicting their trunks and leaves.

artworks.title: Two Apprentices Fighting
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures wrestling in a grand architectural interior. The scene takes place inside a structured hall with Romanesque architectural features, such as rounded arches, fluted columns, and intricate brickwork. The hall extends into the background, with repeated archways leading into darkness. In the foreground, the two figures are in mid-struggle, set against the stone texture. Their attire suggests a historical period with tunics and boots. Objects like a broken wheel, bucket, and tools are on the ground. Flames and smoke rise from a basin on the right, adding dynamism. The detailed line work and shading create a dramatic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Je suis vengé de toi: l'on te hait, et l'on m'aime
artworks.medium: red chalk and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene depicting several figures in period attire. The drawing shows an interaction among multiple individuals, with one holding a sword and another gesturing towards them. The figures are dressed in elaborate garments and are set against a backdrop that includes grand columns and throned chairs. The architecture features high ceilings and a hint of towers or structures beyond, adding to the sense of depth. The drawing is intricately detailed and focuses on the dramatic interaction between characters.

artworks.title: Quoi donc, les vrais Chrétiens auraient tant de vertu
artworks.medium: red chalk and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical architectural scene with a gathering of figures in conversation. The drawing is created using a monochrome palette. The scene is set against a backdrop of grand architectural elements such as large columns and an intricately decorated building facade, with a tower visible in the distance under a partly cloudy sky. The figures are arranged in interaction, with one seated in the center. The attire and postures of the figures evoke a historical or mythological setting, with detailed attention to drapery and movement. The drawing's composition and handling of detail reflects a mastery of form and perspective.

artworks.title: Quoi donc, les vrais Chretiens auraient tant de vertu!
artworks.artist: Antoine-Jean Duclos after Hubert François Gravelot
artworks.description: This drawing depicts several figures in classical attire interacting in a space framed by tall columns and an architectural backdrop. The scene showcases detailed figures and architecture with richly draped garments, ornate columns, and a large, embellished building. Light and shadow play across the drawing, creating depth and emphasizing the drama and movement of the figures. The composition and style suggest an influence from classical themes.

artworks.title: Calmine, quel objet vient Effrayer ma vue?
artworks.description: Three figures are shown in full-body view. Two individuals on the left are standing, facing the third person on the right, who is leaning against a large, patterned object. The two standing figures have their arms extended towards the leaning person. All three individuals are wearing voluminous, flowing garments resembling historical or theatrical robes. The figures on the left have their hair decorated or covered with fabric, while the figure on the right has a substantial head covering forming a turban or elaborate hat. The person leaning against the object holds a staff or long object in one hand. The background features architectural elements like tall pillars, a designed ceiling, and a chandelier above. A draped curtain adds a luxurious element to the setting.

artworks.title: Du plus grand des Romains voilà ce qui vous reste
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowded scene in an architectural setting. The drawing depicts a group of individuals gathered in an elaborate architectural environment featuring columns and ornate balconies. In the center, a figure appears to be in a reclining position, surrounded by other characters. The figures are adorned in draped garments. Architectural details include a lion head ornament, chains, and decorative elements on the buildings. The scene conveys a dramatic narrative frozen in time, with detailed expressions and postures of the figures conveying movement and emotion.

artworks.title: Quoi! Vous servez Valois...
artworks.medium: red chalk and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows four people in an indoor setting. Three individuals appear to be women and one appears to be a man. The woman in the foreground is seated on an ornate chair, turned slightly to her right. She has wavy hair and wears a gown with detailed ruffles or lace. Next to her, another woman stands with her body slightly turned to the right. She has similarly styled hair and wears a gown embellished with horizontal patterns. Behind them, a third person stands with only her upper body visible. On the right, a man is seated on a curved-back chair, leaning slightly forward towards the seated woman. He gestures with one hand towards her. The fourth person, another man, stands on the far right, draped in a cape and holding a cane. The background is a richly decorated interior with tall columns, intricate paneling on the walls, and an ornate ceiling.
